title: Ep 30 — Grok Bot Learns to Audit Your Vendor Contracts, and the Bug-Bite Scanner Clearing Nearly Three Thousand Dollars a Month
description: xAI's Grok Bot proved it can audit enterprise vendor contracts and find real six-figure savings, Google made private company knowledge bases generally available in Gemini Enterprise, and Anthropic shipped a context-hygiene command for Claude Code. Plus a deep dive into an AI insect-bite identification app clearing nearly two thousand eight hundred dollars a month in RevenueCat-verified revenue, and why the UK EV destination-charging gap enters its thirteenth quiet episode for EV-Partnerships.
